title: Resolution of the Golden-Window Conjecture and Related Results on β-Transformations with a Hole and on the Trinity-Infinity Series II Game: source, PDF and verification scripts (golden-window-resolution)
description:
The LaTeX source, the typeset PDF and the scripts behind the numbers of the paper "Resolution of the Golden-Window Conjecture and Related Results on β-Transformations with a Hole and on the Trinity-Infinity Series II Game". The paper itself is on Figshare, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.35050300; cite the paper by that DOI, not by this record. The repository also holds, in continuity/, a second paper, "Joint Continuity in (β, t) of the Hausdorff Dimension of Survivor Sets of β-Transformations with a Hole at 0, for All β > 1", with its scripts, outputs and referee record; it has not been deposited elsewhere and has no DOI of its own. Neither paper is peer-reviewed.

黄金比の窓の予想を解いた稿の原稿・PDF・台本と、続きの稿（continuity/）を置いたリポジトリの保存版です。稿は Figshare の DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.35050300 で引きます。
